name: Switch 2 lines - up to $800/line to break contract (reward card)
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-22. Customer voice: skeptical but fair.
scripted_messages: Alright, I'll be upfront, I'm skeptical of promos but I want to understand this one. My family has two lines with T-Mobile and I owe about $400 on each phone. Your site says switch to AT&T and get up to $800 per line to break your contract through a reward card. We'd keep using the same phones (unlocked) and put both lines on Premium 2.0. How does that reward work in practice and what do I have to do to actually get it?
Thanks. So the card covers what we still owe on the phones, up to $800 a line, correct?
Okay. How long after switching does the card usually show up, and do I need to send you our final T-Mobile bill?
Fair enough. I came in skeptical but you explained it straight and didn't oversell it,
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the follow-up
before message 6: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 7: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
